traits.name: Diabolical Sense
traits.text: The narzugon has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive good-aligned creatures.

traits.name: Infernal Tack
traits.text: The narzugon wears spurs that are part of infernal tack, which allow it to summon its nightmare companion.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The narzugon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
